biggest_catch: Bonus value (estimated ~$600 for 100,000 Marriott points at 0.6¢ each, plus a Free Night Award worth up to 50,000 points ≈ ~$300) minus the $125 annual fee = ~$775 first-year net if you use the free night, ~$475 without it; only pursue it with spending already planned.
catches: Only pursue this bonus with spending you were already going to make — manufactured or extra spending can erase the gain.

Amex once-per-lifetime rule: the welcome offer is generally not available if you have or have had this exact card before; Amex also considers your history as an Amex Card Member and the number of cards opened/closed.
Applying for this card triggers a hard credit inquiry — do not apply unless you are ready for it.
This card's purchase APR is roughly 20%+; carrying a balance can wipe out the entire bonus — pay the statement balance in full every month.
The Free Night Award is worth at most 50,000 points, expires 1 year from issuance, cannot be transferred or extended, and excludes resort fees and incidentals.
Offer ends 11/4/2026 at 11:59 PM MST — apply before then or it is gone.

Chase Marriott exclusions: not available if you had certain Chase Marriott cards in the last 30 days, acquired certain Chase Marriott cards in the last 90 days, or earned a Chase Marriott new-cardmember bonus in the last 24 months.
You must be a legitimate business to apply — a sole proprietor applying with an SSN qualifies; the account will only be used for business purposes per the issuer's terms.

steps: Open the official Amex Marriott Bonvoy Business terms page and confirm the 100,000-point + Free Night Award offer and the 11/4/2026 end date.
Confirm you have not had this card before and none of the Chase Marriott exclusion windows apply to you.
Apply through the official Amex application before 11/4/2026; link your Marriott Bonvoy member account. Legitimate business required — sole proprietor with SSN is fine.
Spend $8,000 in planned purchases in the first 6 months (your real window may be shorter — spend early).
Pay the balance in full every month; interest erases hotel points fast.
Watch your Marriott Bonvoy account — points and the Free Night Award post 8–12 weeks after you reach the threshold; use the free night within 1 year.
timing: Bonus points and the Free Night Award will appear on your Marriott Bonvoy member account 8–12 weeks after you reach the Threshold Amount.
